correctness.rationale: The exact rank-permutation reduction holds under independent continuous marginals. Without-replacement second and fourth moments establish common E(Q) and E(Q^2). The displayed partition-lattice Möbius identity enumerates all 203 equality partitions of the six character factors; a deterministic standalone integer-polynomial certificate checks the three symbolic sixth-moment rational identities for all admissible n. Algebraic centering and positive factorization give the three-class theorem and strict signs; full permutation enumeration at n=7 and n=9 independently checks three moments. Remaining analytic input is elementary character orthogonality and uniform injective image law; finite sampling is not used to extrapolate.

value.rationale: The squared nonzero permutation-DFT coefficient is a canonical distribution-free rank-independence spectral building block. Its complete odd-sample third moment sharply separates two arithmetically exceptional order-three frequency classes although the first two moments are identical. At the smallest revealing size n=9, the differences are explicit and substantial, and their strict sign extends to every admissible divisible-by-three size. Exact null skewness is a logically motivated input for component calibration; no claim of improved omnibus-test power is made.
